\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar=3pt,bar width=10pt,width=10cm,height=7cm,
  xmin=0.4,xmax=3.6,ymin=0,ymax=7,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={1,2,3},ytick={0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7},ymajorgrids,legend pos=north west]
  \addplot[teal,very thick,dashed] coordinates {(1,3) (2,2) (3,4)};
  \addplot[fill=orange,draw=none,fill opacity=.4] coordinates {(1,2) (2,4) (3,3)};
  \addplot[draw=blue,fill=yellow,line width=1.2pt,draw opacity=.5,fill opacity=.65]
    coordinates {(1,4) (2,3) (3,5)};
  \legend{Outline,Fill only,Two inks}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
